name: Mail
description: Read-only Gmail access for the owner and their bound agent: status, search, message and thread reads, and LIVE new-mail notices.

extensions.description: Contributes Mail health and unread counts (never subjects, senders, or bodies) to the owner's bound agent
Projects new-mail notices and Mail health changes onto the owner's confidential Nova LIVE

permissions.reason: OAuth token exchange, refresh, and revocation
Owner consent page opened in the owner's browser
Ephemeral loopback listener receiving the OAuth redirect during a consent attempt

Bundled attachment text extractor (backend/extractor/, never PATH), started once per PDF, HTML, calendar or email attachment read, inside a Windows job object (512 MB, 15 s, one process, no UI): bytes in on stdin, text out on stdout, no network, nothing written to disk
